descriptions.overview: Each descriptions.*: an Operations page's intro under its title (the page is the matching sections.*.label in the operations namespace). "Turns": one answer from a socio (an AI agent) to a message. "Tokens": units the AI model counts text in.
descriptions.activity: Intro under the title of the Activity page of Operations. "Socios" are AI agents (product noun); "channels": where messages come from (web app, Telegram, schedules...).
descriptions.value: Intro under the title of the Value page of Operations: which sessions end completed or abandoned, and how often people return.
descriptions.themes: "Intents": what a person wanted from a session (asking, writing, analyzing…); "topics": what they talked about.
descriptions.knowledge: Intro under the title of the Knowledge page of Operations. "Spaces" is a product noun (shared areas of pages); "datasets": tables of data.
descriptions.reliability: "Fallbacks": a turn that moved to another model after the first failed.
descriptions.capabilities: Intro under the title of the Capabilities page of Operations. "Socios" are AI agents (product noun).
descriptions.health: Intro under the title of the Health page of Operations: AI models, job queues, schedules, backups and how up to date the dashboard's data is.
descriptions.cost: "Backends": where a model runs (a provider's API, a self-hosted server); "cost pools": a self-hosted backend's running costs, shared out over its turns.
descriptions.access-log: "Trace": a turn's record of what the model and tools did.
descriptions.socio-access: Intro under the title of the Socio access page of Operations: which socios (AI agents) may use which connected apps on whose behalf, with a way to end that access.
descriptions.settings: "Reporting time zone": the zone days are cut in on every chart. "Price sync": fetching model prices from their publishers.
pending: A placeholder for a page not built yet. {{section}} is the page's name (one of sections.*.label in the operations namespace).
range.label: Accessible name of the group of buttons that pick the time range the dashboard shows.
range.short.24h: Each range.short.*: a range button's text, as short as possible (24 hours, 7 days, 30 days, 90 days, 12 months). Its tooltip is the matching range.long.*.
range.short.7d: Range button: the last 7 days; as short as possible.
range.short.30d: Range button: the last 30 days; as short as possible.
range.short.90d: Range button: the last 90 days; as short as possible.
range.short.12m: Range button: the last 12 months; as short as possible.
range.short.all: Range button: all the data there is.
range.long.24h: Each range.long.*: the full name of a time range, in the range button's tooltip.
range.long.all: Tooltip of the All range button: all the data there is.
range.custom: Range button that opens From and To date fields for a range of the admin's choosing.
range.points: Accessible name of the menu that picks how a chart groups its points (by hour, by day…).
range.bucket.hour: Each range.bucket.*: a choice in the chart points menu.
range.bucket.day: Choice in the chart points menu: one point per day.
range.bucket.week: Choice in the chart points menu: one point per week.
range.bucket.month: Choice in the chart points menu: one point per month.
range.time-zone: Beside the range bar: days are cut in this time zone. {{zone}} is an IANA zone name, such as America/New_York; keep it as is.
range.from: Label of the first day of a custom range.
range.to: Label of the last day of a custom range.
range.show: Button that applies a custom range.
range.filters: Accessible name of the list of filters that narrow the dashboard (a socio, a person…).
range.filter.socio: Each range.filter.*: what a filter narrows the dashboard to. "Socio" is a product noun (an AI agent); "Space" too (a shared area of pages); "Source" is a channel a message came through (web, Telegram…).
range.filter.person: Filter chip name: the dashboard narrowed to one person.
range.filter.space: Filter chip name: the dashboard narrowed to one Space (a shared area of pages; product noun).
range.filter.source: Filter chip name: the dashboard narrowed to one channel messages came through (web, Telegram…).
range.filter-value: A filter's chip: {{filter}} is one of range.filter.*, {{value}} the name it narrows to (a socio's, a person's…).
range.clear: Accessible name of a filter chip's remove button. {{filter}} is the chip's text (range.filter-value).
status.unavailable: Above the numbers when the analytics store doesn't run on this server.
status.starting: Status line above the dashboard's numbers while the analytics store is starting up.
status.rebuilding: Above the numbers while the analytics store rebuilds its tables from the data.
status.rebuilding-progress: The same, with how far along it is ({{progress}}, a share shown as a percentage).
status.empty: Above the numbers when the analytics store is running but has copied no data yet.
status.as-of: Above the numbers: how fresh they are. {{when}} is a date and time, {{zone}} the reporting time zone's IANA name.
week-of: A chart point that sums a week: {{day}} is its first day, a short date.
change.same: On a stat tile: the value is the same as in the period before.
change.new: On a stat tile: there was nothing in the period before, so there is no percentage.
change.versus: On a stat tile: {{change}} is a signed percentage (+12%, −3%) or change.same/change.new; {{against}} is what it compares with (one of previous*).
previous: What a stat tile compares with: the period of the same length before the one shown. Fits change.versus's {{against}}. The previous_* forms are for each named range (24 hours, 7 days…).
telegram-team: In place of a person's name: a shared Telegram topic, used by a team rather than one person.
totals: Accessible name of a row of stat tiles.
outcomes.completed: Each outcomes.*: how a session (a stretch of one chat) ended. Completed: the work got done.
outcomes.answered: The session got an answer, with no sign the work was finished or abandoned.
outcomes.abandoned: The person left the work unfinished.
outcomes.share: Part of an outcome bar's accessible name: {{outcome}} is one of outcomes.*, {{share}} a percentage.
intents.label: Accessible name of the table of sessions grouped by intent (what people wanted: asking, writing, analyzing…).
intents.sessions: Column heading in the table of sessions by intent: how many sessions.
intents.people: Column heading in the table of sessions by intent: how many people.
intents.completed: Column heading: the share of sessions that were completed.
intents.abandoned: Column heading: the share of sessions that were abandoned.
intents.outcomes: Column heading: a bar of how the sessions ended.
intents.none: In place of an intent: sessions the model hasn't given one.
